response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced senior/staff-level engineer with genuine geospatial depth (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS, FOSS4G talk) and demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput backend work at Sociomantic using D with async I/O, fibers and caching — both relevant analogues for a routing tiling pipeline. However, the core requirement of modern C++ (or Rust) is not met: his only C/C++ professional exposure was roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014–2015, with no Rust and no C++ in the last decade. His recent work is overwhelmingly TypeScript/Node.js product engineering, and there is no navigation guidance or routing-tile/map-data pipeline experience, nor evidence of distributed-systems fundamentals like consistency or service discovery at production scale. He is a plausible long-shot for a team willing to invest in ramp-up on C++, but not a direct match.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS platform experience, including an open-source map-data platform
Proven low-latency, high-volume systems work (millions of req/s, async I/O, fibers)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, Linux/Docker/Kubernetes
concerns: Modern C++ experience is minimal and over 10 years old; no Rust
No navigation/routing or map-tile pipeline experience
Recent roles are web/full-stack TypeScript, not systems-level infrastructure
